flaws.summary: Codex installer hashed newline-normalized text instead of destination bytes
Bootstrap and Codex recovery metadata lived only in disposable runtime
Task identifiers and mutable task identity could redirect state paths
Manual or stale evidence could be treated as direct current proof
Law collections and property cases could pass vacuously
Law subprocess output, environment, and descendant lifetime were unbounded
Module discovery accepted shallow schemas and unsafe entrypoints
Static Codex TOML was conflated with effective live child behavior
Manifest regeneration could bless unreviewed invariant tampering
Context freshness accepted weak caller assertions and raced source reads
Subagent lease release lacked full owner binding and handoff updates were split
Workspace Git probe failures and external dependencies could fail open
Multi-file rollback could mutate one destination before discovering ambiguity in another
Rolling state and its current anchor back together bypassed local history detection
Caller-labelled proof, deletable gates or risks, and post-final evidence could manufacture or corrupt finalization
A local module action could commit a rewrite of core hard-invariant policy
A Windows directory junction could redirect StateStore reads outside the project control root
Polling missed transient acceptance-test mutation when bytes and timestamps were restored
Traceability accepted an incomplete failing ledger and an invalid per-requirement evidence seal
Batch recovery could roll back an earlier journal before discovering ambiguity in a later journal
